Third-party software shipped with Veil for Windows: Tor
=======================================================

Veil's "New Tor window" runs the unmodified `tor` daemon from the official Tor Expert Bundle published by the
Tor Project (https://www.torproject.org/download/tor/). Veil does not implement or modify the Tor protocol.
The bundle is placed in the "tor" folder next to Veil.exe (see windows\scripts\fetch_tor.ps1, which also records
the exact release in tor\VERSION.txt).

The tor binaries also contain or link third-party libraries (for example libevent, zlib and OpenSSL) under their own
licenses. The complete, authoritative license text for the exact release you ship is the LICENSE file of the Tor
source code for that release (https://gitlab.torproject.org/tpo/core/tor) plus the notices of those libraries.
BEFORE DISTRIBUTING a build, add those texts (or ship any license files that come inside the bundle, which the
build copies automatically) - this notice is not a substitute for them.

traffic is routed through the Tor network. Veil is not Tor Browser and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the
Tor Project; see https://www.torproject.org/about/trademark/ before using their logo or name in marketing.
